The fourth world of pink (पीत) soil and resi- dence of daityas like कालनेमि.
4: Br. II. २०. १२, १४, ३२-34.
[page१-038+ ३२]
--an underworld of dark earth; here is the house of Namuci, the Indra of the Asuras besides those of शङ्कुकर्ण, नागस्, राक्षसस्, etc. White soil. वा. ५०. ११, १३ and १५-19. Vi.
--Those who set fire to buildings, administer poison, lift their weapons to strike, or practise आभिचार or become talebearers or seditionists. M. २२७. ११६-9.
--a son of उषा and विभावसु. A Vasu. Father of पञ्चयाम. भा.
